name: n8n
description: n8n (SQLite by default, optional Postgres): with the default SQLite setup the data volume (~/.n8n incl. database.sqlite) is captured as a file copy (crash-consistent; 'No database detected' at create is then expected). If the stack runs the Postgres variant, DB auto-detection dumps it properly. CRITICAL: the N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY (env or ~/.n8n/config inside the volume) encrypts all stored credentials - it is inside the backup, but keep an offline copy; without it restored workflows lose their credentials.
